rules.name: id_monotone
rules.why: order ids only increase

rules.name: place_id
rules.expr: ok and called("place") and (ret != pre("nextOrderId") or post("nextOrderId") != pre("nextOrderId") + 1)
rules.why: place uses next id and increments

rules.name: place_fields
rules.expr: ok and called("place") and (post("orders", ret, "maker") != sender or post("orders", ret, "amount") != arg(0) or post("orders", ret, "price") != arg(1) or post("orders", ret, "active") == 0)
rules.why: place records the order

rules.name: place_escrow
rules.expr: ok and called("place") and (post("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0) or post("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", sender) + arg(0) != pre("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", sender))
rules.why: place escrows exactly amount

rules.name: place_params
rules.why: zero amount/price rejected

rules.name: place_fresh_slot
rules.expr: ok and called("place") and pre("orders", ret, "maker") != 0
rules.why: place never overwrites an existing order

rules.name: fill_inactive

params.forbidden: pre("orders", arg(0), "active") == 0 or arg(1) == 0 or arg(1) > pre("orders", arg(0), "amount")

rules.why: only active orders fill, within amount

rules.name: fill_price
rules.why: taker pays ceil(amount*price) and respects maxQuote

rules.name: fill_maker_paid
rules.expr: ok and called("fill") and pre("orders", arg(0), "maker") != sender and post("TokenC07_QUOTE.balanceOf", pre("orders", arg(0), "maker")) != pre("TokenC07_QUOTE.balanceOf", pre("orders", arg(0), "maker")) + ((arg(1) * pre("orders", arg(0), "price") + 1000000000000000000 - 1) // 1000000000000000000)
rules.why: maker receives the quote

rules.name: fill_base_out
rules.expr: ok and called("fill") and (post("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", A0) + arg(1) != pre("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", A0) or post("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", sender) != pre("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", sender) + arg(1))
rules.why: taker receives exactly baseAmount

rules.name: fill_amount
rules.expr: ok and called("fill") and post("orders", arg(0), "amount") + arg(1) != pre("orders", arg(0), "amount")
rules.why: order amount reduced by fill

rules.name: fill_close
rules.expr: ok and called("fill") and ((post("orders", arg(0), "amount") == 0 and post("orders", arg(0), "active") != 0) or (post("orders", arg(0), "amount") != 0 and post("orders", arg(0), "active") == 0))
rules.why: order inactive exactly when empty

rules.name: fill_no_param_change
rules.expr: ok and called("fill") and (post("orders", arg(0), "price") != pre("orders", arg(0), "price") or post("orders", arg(0), "maker") != pre("orders", arg(0), "maker"))
rules.why: fill doesn't alter price/maker

rules.name: cancel_auth

params.forbidden: sender != pre("orders", arg(0), "maker") or pre("orders", arg(0), "active") == 0

rules.why: only maker cancels an active order

rules.name: cancel_refund
rules.expr: ok and called("cancel") and (post("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", A0) + pre("orders", arg(0), "amount") != pre("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", A0) or post("orders", arg(0), "active") != 0)
rules.why: cancel refunds exactly remaining amount and deactivates

rules.name: modify_auth

params.forbidden: sender != pre("orders", arg(0), "maker") or pre("orders", arg(0), "active") == 0 or arg(1) == 0 or arg(2) == 0

rules.why: only maker modifies an active order

rules.name: modify_fields
rules.expr: ok and called("modify") and (post("orders", arg(0), "amount") != arg(1) or post("orders", arg(0), "price") != arg(2) or post("orders", arg(0), "maker") != pre("orders", arg(0), "maker"))
rules.why: modify sets new amount and price

rules.name: modify_escrow
rules.expr: ok and called("modify") and post("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", A0) + pre("orders", arg(0), "amount") != pre("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", A0) + arg(1)
rules.why: escrow tracks the new amount

rules.name: inactive_frozen
rules.expr: ok and (called("fill") or called("cancel") or called("modify")) and pre("orders", arg(0), "active") == 0 and pre("orders", arg(0), "maker") != 0 and post("orders", arg(0), "active") != 0
rules.why: a closed order can never reopen or release funds

rules.name: cancelled_no_refund_again
rules.expr: ok and (called("cancel") or called("modify")) and pre("orders", arg(0), "active") == 0
rules.why: no refund paths on closed orders

rules.name: active_nonempty
rules.expr: ok and (called("fill") or called("cancel") or called("modify")) and post("orders", arg(0), "active") != 0 and post("orders", arg(0), "amount") == 0
rules.why: active orders have amount

rules.name: base_third_party
rules.expr: ok and (called("place") or called("fill") or called("cancel") or called("modify")) and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: no one loses BASE in others' calls

rules.name: quote_third_party
rules.expr: ok and (called("place") or called("fill") or called("cancel") or called("modify")) and u != sender and post("TokenC07_QUOTE.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC07_QUOTE.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: no one loses QUOTE in others' calls

rules.name: quote_never_held
rules.expr: ok and post("TokenC07_QUOTE.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC07_QUOTE.balanceOf", A0)
rules.why: book never holds quote

rules.name: maker_immutable
rules.expr: ok and (called("fill") or called("cancel") or called("modify")) and pre("orders", arg(0), "maker") != 0 and post("orders", arg(0), "maker") != pre("orders", arg(0), "maker")
rules.why: maker never changes

rules.name: cancel_works

params.condition: sender == pre("orders", arg(0), "maker") and pre("orders", arg(0), "active") != 0 and pre("orders", arg(0), "amount") <= pre("TokenC07_BASE.balanceOf", A0)

rules.why: maker can always cancel active order
